mapper.select: SELECT so.id, so.outbound_no, so.platform, so.warehouse_id, so.outbound_date, so.order_count, so.sku_count, so.total_quantity, so.order_status, so.posting_id, so.logistics_product_id, so.document_mode, lp.product_name AS logistics_product_name, so.channel_name, so.tracking_no, so.weight, so.shipping_fee, so.remark, so.create_by, so.create_time FROM wms_sales_outbound_order so LEFT JOIN wms_logistics_product lp ON lp.id = so.logistics_product_id WHERE so.id = #{id}
